items.title: Orange Pi Zero 4 – Compact Allwinner A733 SBC offers HDMI, USB-C DP, GbE, WiFI 6, PCIe FFC connector for $26.5 and up
items.summary: Orange Pi Zero 4 is an affordable yet feature-rich Allwinner A733 single board computer (SBC) with up to 8GB RAM, eMMC/UFS storage footprint, a microSD card slot, and plenty of I/Os. The board packs mini HDMI and USB-C DisplayPort, Gigabit Ethernet, WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4, two MIPI CSI camera connectors, a Raspberry Pi-style PCIe FFC connector, and two GPIO headers into a compact 55x50mm form factor. Orange Pi Zero 4 specifications: SoC – Allwinner A733 CPU Dual-core Arm Cortex-A76 @ up to 2.00 GHz Hexa-core Arm Cortex-A55 @ up to 1.79 GHz Single-core RISC-V E902 real-time core up to 200 MHz GPU – Imagination Technologies BXM-4-64 MC1 GPU with support for OpenGL ES 3.2, Vulkan 1.3, OpenCL 3.0 VPU 8Kp24 H.265/VP9/AVS2 decoding 4Kp30 H.265/H.264 encoding AI accelerator – 3 TOPS NPU System Memory – 1GB, 2GB, 4GB, 6GB, or 8GB LPDDR5/LPDDR4/LPDDR4x; note: 16GB is also listed in the specs, [...] The post Orange Pi Zero 4 – Compact Allwinner A733 SBC offers HDMI, USB-C DP, GbE, WiFI 6, PCIe FFC connector for $26.5 and up appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: StarFive Dubhe-100 – A 64-bit, RVA23-compliant RISC-V core for high-performance applications
items.summary: StarFive has launched a new high-performance 64-bit RISC-V core from the Dubhe family with the RVA23-compliant Dubhe-100 designed for servers and HPC, as well as other high-performance applications. The new RISC-V IP core delivers a SPECint2006 score of 15/GHz, supports Vector and Vector Crypto extensions, and features a deep out-of-order design with a 15-stage pipeline and 6-wide issue. StarFive Dubhe-100 key features and specifications: ISA – RV64GCBVH 15-stage pipeline, 6-issue Superscalar, deep out-of-order execution Support Multi-core cache coherence Support instruction fusion Support AIA1.0 Performance SPECint2006: 15/GHz Dhrystone v2.2: 10.0/MHz (legal) HPM (Hardware Performance Monitor) RISC-V standard HPM support Micro-architecture level analysis and performance tuning PMP & PMA (Physical Memory Protection / Physical Memory Attributes) Configurable 16/32/64 PMP supported regions, minimum 4096-byte region size Support predefined PMA and Svpbmt Debug & Trace Standard debug module compliant with RISC-V Debug Spec Standard Trace module interface compliant with RISC-V Trace Spec Power Management [...] The post StarFive Dubhe-100 – A 64-bit, RVA23-compliant RISC-V core for high-performance applications appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.summary: Nordic Semiconductor has launched the nRF93M1 DK (Development Kit) based on the nRF93M1-LABA LTE Cat 1 bis with Wi-Fi and cellular location and a Nordic Semi nRF54L15 host microcontroller. The nRF93M1 module was first introduced at Embedded World 2026 last March, and the company has now announced general availability of the nRF93M1-LABA smart modem module for Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and sampling of the nRF93M1-LACA module for global markets, scheduled to become available in Q3 2026. items.title: Espressif Systems releases a Linux BSP developer preview for ESP32-S31 RISC-V microprocessor
items.summary: The ESP32-S31 microprocessor is getting Linux support from Espressif Systems. The ESP32-S31 dual-core RISC-V microprocessor was first unveiled in March, two ESP32-S31 development boards followed in May, and mass production was announced a few weeks ago. The new RISC-V chip features an MMU (Memory Management Unit), which makes Linux much easier to handle, and the development boards also come with 16MB PSRAM, so a minimal Linux image is possible. Moving from theory to practice, Espressif Systems has now released a developer preview version of the ESP Linux BSP for ESP32-S31, and some community Linux ports are also in the works (more on that at the end of the article). Let’s focus on the official ESP Linux BSP. The aforementioned repo only contains the image layout and packaging tools used by the ESP32-S31 Buildroot integration, and the core of the project can be found in the esp-buildroot-external repo with ESP32-S31 NOR boot [...] The post Espressif Systems releases a Linux BSP developer preview for ESP32-S31 RISC-V microprocessor appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: KAGA FEI ES4L15MA1 is a ridiculously small, ready-to-use BLE 6.0 module based on Nordic nRF54L15 SoC
items.summary: Japanese company KAGA FEI has introduced another incredibly small ES4L15MA1 Bluetooth LE 6.0 module based on Nordic Semiconductor’s nRF54L15 ultra-low-power Cortex-M33 wireless MCU. Launched alongside the larger EC4L15MA1 module, the ES4L15MA1 module appears to be based on the same hardware as the ES4L15BA1 “world’s smallest module” unveiled in 2024 with an 8.55 x 3.25 x 1.00 mm form factor. The main difference is that the new modules come with ready-to-use embedded software providing a command-based API via UART to shorten product development cycles and lower development costs for IoT devices relying on Bluetooth LE 6.0 connectivity. items.title: NVIDIA Posts Linux Scheduler Patches To Further Boost SMT Performance On NVIDIA Vera
items.summary: Hitting the Linux kernel mailing list today is a new kernel scheduler patch series to enable preferred SMT siblings for NVIDIA Vera with its Olympus cores...
items.title_zh: NVIDIA发布Linux调度器补丁 进一步提升Vera SMT性能
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA今日向Linux内核邮件列表提交新的调度器补丁系列，为搭载Olympus核心的NVIDIA Vera处理器启用首选SMT兄弟线程支持，旨在进一步提升SMT性能表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该补丁针对NVIDIA自研Vera架构优化SMT调度，反映其在数据中心CPU领域的持续投入。

items.title: AMD Updates UALink Patches To Get The Linux Kernel Ready For UALoE On Helios
items.summary: Earlier this month AMD posted a massive set of patches for bringing up UALink support for the mainline Linux kernel and wiring it up into the AMDGPU kernel driver. In closing out the month of August, they have updated this big set of Ultra Accelerator Link patches...
items.title_zh: AMD更新UALink补丁，为Linux内核支持Helios的UALoE做准备
items.summary_zh: 本月初AMD发布了一批大规模补丁，将UALink支持引入Linux主线内核，并接入AMDGPU内核驱动。在八月底，AMD再次更新了这批Ultra Accelerator Link补丁，以完善相关实现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: UALink是面向AI加速器互联的开放标准，Linux内核支持的推进有助于构建开放加速器生态。

items.title: Linux Kernel Patches Out For Review To Enable USB4/Thunderbolt For Apple M1 / M2 / M3
items.summary: There is a set of 19 patches out for review on the Linux kernel mailing list that would finally allow the mainline kernel running on Apple Silicon M1 / M2 / M3 SoCs to enjoy USB4/Thunderbolt support...
items.title_zh: Linux内核补丁提交审查，为Apple M1/M2/M3启用USB4/Thunderbolt支持
items.summary_zh: Linux内核邮件列表上出现了一组共19个补丁，可让运行在Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3 SoC上的主线内核获得USB4与Thunderbolt支持，弥补了长期缺失的高速I/O能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该补丁填补了Apple Silicon在主线Linux上长期缺失的高速I/O支持，提升平台扩展性与外设兼容性。

items.title: New Linux Patches Tune AMD Ryzen Zen 6 To Optimize Performance & Power Consumption
items.summary: Ahead of the next-generation AMD Ryzen Zen 6 client processors debuting, an important patch series was posted overnight to the Linux kernel mailing list. These patches provide new Zen 6 client Energy Performance Preference "EPP" tunings that are important for optimizing performance and power consumption for these upcoming AMD Zen 6 desktop and laptop processors...
items.title_zh: Linux内核新补丁为AMD Ryzen Zen 6优化性能与功耗
items.summary_zh: AMD下一代Ryzen Zen 6客户端处理器发布前夕，Linux内核邮件列表发布重要补丁系列，新增Zen 6专用的EPP（Energy Performance Preference）调优参数，用于优化桌面和笔记本平台的性能与功耗表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 反映Linux内核对新硬件平台的提前适配，Zen 6能效调优将直接影响终端用户体验与OEM产品规划。

items.title: Another x86 Advisory From Some Entity Other Than Intel Or AMD
items.summary: Last October I highlighted an interesting post on the Linux kernel mailing list around an x86 corporate entity other than Intel or AMD that left mysterious intrigue. The developer that detailed those x86 opcode/CPUID/MSR allocations back in July then detailed 16-tile and 32-tile AMX implementations again for something outside the current scope of Intel/AMD processors. Today another message is being relayed from that "corporate entity other than Intel/AMD."..
items.title_zh: 非Intel/AMD的神秘x86企业实体再次发布新公告
items.summary_zh: Linux内核邮件列表再次出现来自一家非Intel也非AMD的神秘x86企业实体的消息。该开发者此前已披露过x86操作码、CPUID、MSR分配以及16-tile和32-tile AMX实现细节，引发业界对未知x86参与者的广泛关注与猜测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 暗示x86生态可能迎来新的市场参与者，对Intel与AMD双寡头格局构成潜在变数。

items.title: Microduck – A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun
items.summary: Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects. This follows the launch of the Reachy Mini desktop robot earlier this year that featured a Raspberry Pi CM4 module or could interface to a computer instead. In some ways, we may think of the Microduck as a Reachy Mini with legs, but the company says both are different products. The Reachy Mini targets human-robot interaction, while the Microduck focuses on motion/action, although it also features a microphone and a speaker for audio interaction. Microduck specifications: SoC – Rockchip RK3566 CPU – Quad-core Cortex-A55 processor @ up to 1.8 GHz GPU – Arm Mali-G52 NPU – 0.8 TOPS AI accelerator VPU 4Kp60 H.265/H.264/VP9 video decoder 1080p60 H.264/H.265 video encoder System Memory – 1GB RAM Storage [...] The post Microduck – A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Pollen Robotics与Hugging Face发布双足机器人Microduck
items.summary_zh: Microduck高25厘米，搭载15个电机，配有摄像头、深度传感器、两枚运动传感器和可张合的机械喙，可用于抓取物体与动作实验。其采用Rockchip RK3566，面向物理AI和机器人研究。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将桌面级AI机器人拓展到双足动作与交互研究，且硬件配置完整，适合教育和快速原型开发。

items.title: Lantronix Open-M 720G/520G – Ultra-compact LGA system-on-modules based on MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs
items.summary: Lantronix Open-M 720G and 520G are compact (43x44mm) LGA system-on-modules (SoM) powered by 6nm MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs, offering an AI performance of 10 TOPS, and designed for Edge IoT applications running low-power Vision AI and GenAI tasks. The Genio 720 dual-camera module ships with 8GB LPDDR5 and the Genio 520 single-camera module with 4GB LPDDR5. Both offer 128GB UFS storage, Gigabit Ethernet, optional WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, dual display support, audio inputs/outputs, USB 3.2/2.0 interfaces, PCIe Gen2 x1, and more. Lantronix Open-M 720G/520G specifications: SoC (one or the other) MediaTek Genio 520 (MT8371) CPU – 2x Cortex-A78 up to 2.2GHz, 6x Cortex-A55 up to 2.0 GHz GPU – Arm Mali-G57 MC2 up to 880 MHz VPU Video Decode – Up to 1920 x 1200 @ 60fps Video Encode – Up to 1920 x 1200 @ 60fps ISP – 1x ISP NPU – NPU850 AI accelerator [...] The post Lantronix Open-M 720G/520G – Ultra-compact LGA system-on-modules based on MediaTek Genio 720 and Genio 520 SoCs appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: Lantronix推出基于MediaTek Genio的Open-M 720G/520G模块
items.summary_zh: Lantronix发布43×44毫米的Open-M 720G/520G LGA系统级模块，分别采用MediaTek Genio 720/520，面向Edge IoT视觉AI与GenAI。两款产品支持双摄或单摄、128GB UFS、千兆以太网，并可选Wi-Fi 6和Bluetooth 5.3。
items.why_it_matters_zh: Genio 720/520将10 TOPS AI性能、丰富接口与低功耗设计整合到紧凑模块中，适合边缘视觉和GenAI设备开发。

items.title: $299 Arduino Ventuno Q SBC combines Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 SoC and STM32H5 MCU
items.summary: The Arduino Ventuno Q is a single board computer pairing a Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 (IQ-8275) octa-core Edge AI SoC with an STM32H5F5 Arm Cortex-M33 microcontroller for real-time I/Os. First introduced at Embedded World 2026, the Ventuno Q is the second Qualcomm-based Arduino board after the Arduino UNO Q launched in October 2025. It’s quite a different beast with a larger design featuring 16GB LPDDR5, 64GB eMMC flash, an M.2 socket for NVMe storage, 2.5GbE and Wi-Fi 6 networking, a 4K-capable HDMI output, and two USB 3.2 ports, while still offloading real-time I/O to a Cortex-M33 microcontroller. Arduino Ventuno Q (ABX00181) specifications: SoC – Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 (IQ-8275, also known as QCS8275): CPU – Octa-core Kryo Gen 6 (Arm Cortex-A78/A55) processor GPU – Adreno A623 AI accelerator -Hexagon Tensor AI Processor (NPU) up to 40 dense TOPS ISP – Qualcomm Spectra 692/690 ISP Microcontroller (MCU) – STMicro STM32H5F5 CPU core – [...] The post $299 Arduino Ventuno Q SBC combines Qualcomm Dragonwing IQ8 SoC and STM32H5 MCU appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
